name: 54656 · Sparta, WI
findings: ZIP 54656 (Sparta) has 73 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 54656 (Sparta) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
46% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 54656 (Sparta) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 56% of the typical level).
